title: Chicago, the lobby
logline: The Chicago hotel's lobby from the postcard's back: orange carpet, a bell on a desk, a rack of postcards with the same card she sent in every slot. The page invents a lobby and stocks it with the one thing it has.

panels.composition: A hotel lobby with orange carpet, a desk with a bell, and a wire rack of postcards with the same skyline card repeated in every slot.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a hotel lobby with orange carpet, a desk with a bell and a wire rack of postcards showing the same city skyline card in every slot, no people, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Stocked with the one thing it has.
